newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - Huge call spreads set in ASDA.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Huge call spreads set in ASDA.

text.p: Traders noted very heavy buying of bullish call spreads in ASDA Group options on Thursday, as the underlying stock crept toward its June peak on heavy volume.
Big buyers of ASDA calls, which were easily the most actively-traded equity options, dealers said.
They said 2,000 January 100 calls were bought at 16-1/2p, 1,500 January 110 calls were purchased at 8p and another 1,000 January 120 calls were bought at 4p.
By 1403 GMT, more than 5,000 lots had traded in ASDA options.

Meanwhile, underlying shares in the UK supermarket group were up 1p to 113-1/4p, just 9-1/4p off their June peak. Volume was heavy, with more than 19 million shares trading hands, putting them among the most actively traded shares in London. Marketmakers noted one large buyer of the underlying stock, which contributed to the volume.

Elsewhere, trading in FTSE index options mostly revolved around rollover ahead of the October expiry tomorrow, traders said. Most of the volume in FTSE index options was in the October 4,000 puts and the October 4,050 calls.
